caption: The drawing depicts a spinning wheel composed primarily of wood in natural brown and tan shades. The structure consists of a large, circular wheel on the left, with spokes radiating from the central hub, each spoke tipped with a slightly darkened, leaf-shaped accent. The wheel is mounted on a long, horizontal wooden base that is supported by three angled wooden legs. On the right side of the base, there is a vertical rod which supports the flyer and spindle assembly, featuring two horizontal arms and a pointed spindle protruding to the right. The background is an off-white or cream color with no other objects or patterns, creating a simple and clear visual presentation of the spinning wheel. The artist’s signature, “MAUD HOLME,” is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Spinning Wheel
